You can see my Gameplay Here : https://youtu.be/4d_ySlfgYVA

Town Of The Dead Life 死寂之城 is a... well... strategy/crafting/survival/rpg/citysimulator/tower defense/roguelike/and can continue even more genre XD

Never seen a game with so many genres in my life, but they combine it really well and that it's pretty awsome for a indie chinese game.

There are a lot of administration with this game have to check a lot of resources and normally this kind of games don't like them much but this one makes the administration really deep and addictive and as the towerdefense gameplay it's fun too.

The game has English translation so you guys can play it, and as the price I consider it pretty cheap for all the content there is inside.
